data.title: From idea to production
data.subtitle: Six explicit gates keep every change reviewable and safe.

steps.name: Plan
steps.detail: Set scope and acceptance criteria. Gate: Scope ready.

steps.name: Build
steps.detail: Implement the smallest complete change. Gate: Checks pass.

steps.name: Review
steps.detail: Validate correctness, clarity, and risk. Gate: Clear.

steps.name: Test
steps.detail: Exercise real behavior safely. Gate: Pass.

steps.name: Canary
steps.detail: Release narrowly and observe signals. Gate: Green.

steps.name: Launch
steps.detail: Expand confidently with rollback ready. Gate: Live.

data.footer: Every stage earns the next one — a change that fails a gate stays put until the gate passes.
